lines.text: While Babylon's army attacked Jerusalem, the LORD told Zedekiah he would be captured and taken to Babylon.
The LORD promised Zedekiah he would die in peace, and people would burn spices for him.
Babylon's army was fighting against Lachish and Jericho, the only fortified cities remaining in Judah.
The LORD reminded them to free Hebrew servants every tenth year, a covenant made when He brought their forefathers out of Egypt.
The LORD said He would bring Babylon's army back to fight against the city, capture it, and burn it down.
